purpose: Verify successful submission of a new scholarship application.
preconditions: Student authenticated; scheme published; application window open.
action_or_input: Student selects Apply, enters data, uploads documents, chooses Submit, and confirms submission.
expected_result: System assigns application ID/timestamp, stores policy version, sets state to Submitted, routes verification to SPACS Assistant, and sends notifications.

purpose: Verify saving an application as a draft before submission.
preconditions: Student authenticated; scheme published; application window open.
action_or_input: Student enters data and saves the application before choosing Submit.
expected_result: Application state remains Draft and data is persisted.

purpose: Verify handling of unavailable or invalid reusable documents.
preconditions: Student authenticated; scheme published; application window open; reusable document is invalid/unavailable.
action_or_input: Student attempts to select an invalid reusable document and uploads a replacement.
expected_result: System accepts the replacement document and allows the application process to continue.

purpose: Verify blocking submission when eligibility or completeness validation fails.
preconditions: Student authenticated; scheme published; application window open; application data fails validation.
action_or_input: Student chooses Submit with invalid or incomplete data/documents.
expected_result: System blocks submission and displays deficiencies.

purpose: Verify recovery of draft input after a recoverable timeout or system error.
preconditions: Student is actively entering application data.
action_or_input: A recoverable timeout or system error occurs during data entry.
expected_result: System preserves the recoverable draft input.

purpose: Verify successful verification of a scholarship application.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant authenticated/authorized; application assigned and not finally decided.
action_or_input: Assistant reviews application, records findings, and marks it Verified.
expected_result: System routes the application to the Convener for decision.

purpose: Verify requesting correction from the student.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant authenticated/authorized; application assigned.
action_or_input: Assistant records reason for required information and requests correction.
expected_result: System sets state to Correction Required and notifies the student.

purpose: Verify routing a verification concern or suspected ineligibility.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant authenticated/authorized; application assigned.
action_or_input: Assistant records a verification concern and routes it to the Convener.
expected_result: System records the concern and routes it according to the configured workflow.

purpose: Verify access denial for unauthorized role or assignment.
preconditions: User is not authorized for the specific role or application assignment.
action_or_input: User attempts to open and verify an assigned application.
expected_result: System denies access.

purpose: Verify successful modification and resubmission of a pending application.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is editable (e.g., Correction Required).
action_or_input: Student updates data/documents and resubmits changes.
expected_result: System revalidates content, invalidates prior verification if affected, and routes back to verification.

purpose: Verify handling of validation failure during modification.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is editable.
action_or_input: Student updates data with invalid content and attempts to resubmit.
expected_result: System blocks resubmission; changes may be saved as draft where permitted.

purpose: Verify cancellation of editing without changes.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is editable.
action_or_input: Student cancels editing after opening the application.
expected_result: Persisted data remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify rejection of update when state becomes non-editable concurrently.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is initially editable.
action_or_input: State becomes non-editable concurrently while student is editing, and student attempts to save.
expected_result: System rejects the update and refreshes the current state.

purpose: Verify successful withdrawal of a pending application.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is withdrawable; no final decision.
action_or_input: Student selects Withdraw, provides reason if required, and confirms.
expected_result: System sets state to Withdrawn, closes pending tasks, logs action, and sends notifications.

purpose: Verify blocking withdrawal when not permitted in current state.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is not configured as withdrawable.
action_or_input: Student selects Withdraw.
expected_result: System blocks the request and explains the state restriction.

purpose: Verify rejection of withdrawal when state changes during confirmation.
preconditions: Student owns application; state is initially withdrawable.
action_or_input: State changes to non-withdrawable during the confirmation step.
expected_result: System rechecks and rejects the withdrawal.

purpose: Verify making a final scholarship decision (Approve/Reject).
preconditions: SPACS Convener authenticated/authorized; verified application assigned.
action_or_input: Convener selects Approve or Reject, records reason, and confirms.
expected_result: System records actor, timestamp, outcome, policy version, sets resulting state, and notifies student.

purpose: Verify returning an application for correction by the Convener.
preconditions: SPACS Convener authenticated/authorized; verified application assigned.
action_or_input: Convener records required correction instead of final decision.
expected_result: State becomes Correction Required and student is notified.

purpose: Verify blocking decision when role is not authorized for the scheme.
preconditions: Convener role is not authorized for the specific scheme.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to make a decision on the application.
expected_result: System blocks the decision.

purpose: Verify successful download/print of an owned application by a student.
preconditions: Authenticated student; authorized access to application.
action_or_input: Student selects Download/Print on an authorized application.
expected_result: System generates the export for the authorized record.

purpose: Verify export by authorized staff.
preconditions: Authenticated staff member; permitted by access policy.
action_or_input: Authorized staff selects Download/Print.
expected_result: System generates the export permitted by the access policy.

purpose: Verify denial of export when access check fails.
preconditions: User lacks authorization for the specific application.
action_or_input: User selects Download/Print.
expected_result: System denies the export.

purpose: Verify checking application status by a student.
preconditions: Authenticated student.
action_or_input: Student opens My Applications and selects an application/renewal.
expected_result: System retrieves and displays current state and relevant status history.

purpose: Verify denial of access to unowned or inaccessible records.
preconditions: Authenticated student; attempts to access record not owned.
action_or_input: Student attempts to view status of an unowned record.
expected_result: System denies access.

purpose: Verify successful creation of a draft catalogue entry.
preconditions: Authorized SPACS Convener.
action_or_input: Convener enters metadata, criteria, evidence, dates, and saves as Draft.
expected_result: System validates metadata and creates the draft catalogue entry.

purpose: Verify prevention of save/publish when metadata is invalid or incomplete.
preconditions: Authorized SPACS Convener.
action_or_input: Convener enters invalid or incomplete metadata and attempts to save.
expected_result: System prevents save/publish.

purpose: Verify successful modification of a future/draft catalogue version.
preconditions: Authorized Convener; target version is editable.
action_or_input: Convener opens entry, edits permitted fields/dates, and saves updated draft.
expected_result: System preserves prior published version, records change history, and saves the new version.

purpose: Verify requirement of a new version when attempting to modify historical version in place.
preconditions: Authorized Convener; historical published version exists.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to modify a historical version in place.
expected_result: System requires creation of a new version.

purpose: Verify successful retirement/deactivation of a catalogue entry.
preconditions: Authorized Convener.
action_or_input: Convener opens entry, records retirement details and effective date.
expected_result: System prevents new processing after effective retirement while preserving historical records.

purpose: Verify browsing of published scholarship/award catalogue.
preconditions: User is authenticated.
action_or_input: User opens catalogue, filters/selects an entry.
expected_result: System displays description, eligibility, evidence, dates, and renewal info for published entries.

purpose: Verify successful submission of a scholarship renewal application.
preconditions: Student owns prior award; renewal permitted; window open.
action_or_input: Student selects Renew, updates refreshed data/documents, and submits.
expected_result: System validates criteria, creates new renewal cycle, and routes to SPACS Assistant verification.

purpose: Verify blocking renewal when not eligible or window is closed.
preconditions: Student owns prior award; renewal not eligible or window closed.
action_or_input: Student selects Renew.
expected_result: System blocks start/submission.

purpose: Verify saving a renewal application as a draft.
preconditions: Student owns prior award; renewal permitted; window open.
action_or_input: Student updates data and saves the renewal as draft before submitting.
expected_result: System saves the renewal application as a draft.

purpose: Verify successful preparation of an award candidate pool.
preconditions: Award scheme published; cycle open; policy/method configured.
action_or_input: Convener starts candidate preparation; system obtains candidates and applies rules.
expected_result: Convener reviews and finalizes the pool; pool is Prepared and available to committee.

purpose: Verify handling of missing authoritative data during pool preparation.
preconditions: Award scheme published; cycle open; some candidate records lack authoritative data.
action_or_input: System attempts to obtain candidates using authoritative-record filter.
expected_result: System identifies incomplete candidate records for resolution.

purpose: Verify successful evaluation and shortlisting of award candidates.
preconditions: Committee member authorized; candidate pool prepared; criteria fixed.
action_or_input: Committee reviews evidence, records evaluations, shortlist, and recommendations.
expected_result: System stores committee actors/timestamps and evaluation history.

purpose: Verify recording of pending evidence request during evaluation.
preconditions: Committee member authorized; candidate pool prepared.
action_or_input: Committee determines additional evidence is required and records the request.
expected_result: System records pending evidence/request according to scheme process.

purpose: Verify access denial for unauthorized committee member.
preconditions: User is not an authorized committee member.
action_or_input: User attempts to open candidate pool and policy criteria.
expected_result: System denies access.

purpose: Verify successful recording of final award outcome.
preconditions: Convener authorized; award cycle awaiting finalization; committee recommendation available.
action_or_input: Convener records final approval/rejection outcome and approval reference.
expected_result: System locks/preserves finalization history and marks cycle Ready for Publication when approved.

purpose: Verify blocking publication when required approval is missing.
preconditions: Convener authorized; award cycle awaiting finalization; required approval missing.
action_or_input: System checks for required approval metadata during finalization.
expected_result: System keeps cycle Awaiting Approval and blocks publication.

purpose: Verify successful publication of approved award results.
preconditions: Final approval outcome recorded; cycle Ready for Publication.
action_or_input: Convener reviews final awardees and confirms publication.
expected_result: System publishes results, records timestamp/version, and sends notifications.

purpose: Verify blocking publication when required approval is not recorded.
preconditions: Final approval outcome is NOT recorded.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to select Publish Results.
expected_result: System blocks publication.

purpose: Verify successful viewing of SPACS audit trail.
preconditions: User is authenticated and has audit-view permission.
action_or_input: User filters audit records and views details.
expected_result: System returns protected audit entries accessible to the user read-only.

purpose: Verify denial of unauthorized audit access.
preconditions: User lacks audit-view permission.
action_or_input: User attempts to open Audit Trail.
expected_result: System denies access and optionally logs the attempt.

purpose: Verify successful publication/activation of a catalogue version.
preconditions: Draft/future version complete; required policy approval reference present.
action_or_input: Convener confirms publication after system validates metadata and dates.
expected_result: System sets version Published/Active for its effective period and logs publication.

purpose: Verify blocking publication when approval reference or metadata is missing.
preconditions: Draft/future version is missing approval reference or required metadata.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to Publish/Activate.
expected_result: System blocks publication.

purpose: Verify issuance of SLA reminder/escalation for overdue task.
preconditions: Task remains pending; applicable SLA threshold and recipient configuration exist.
action_or_input: Configured SLA reminder or escalation threshold is reached.
expected_result: System sends configured notification and records the event; application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify no reminder is sent if task is completed before processing.
preconditions: Task is pending; SLA threshold is reached.
action_or_input: Task is completed concurrently before the reminder service processes the threshold.
expected_result: No reminder/escalation is sent.

purpose: Verify issuance of next-stage notification when a later threshold is reached.
preconditions: Earlier reminder was already sent; later threshold is configured.
action_or_input: Later SLA threshold is reached.
expected_result: System issues only the configured next-stage notification.

purpose: Verify handling of notification delivery failure.
preconditions: Task pending; SLA threshold reached; notification mechanism fails.
action_or_input: System attempts to send reminder/escalation but delivery fails.
expected_result: Failed delivery is recorded and retried/handled; business task state is not changed.

purpose: Verify sending of scholarship renewal reminder.
preconditions: Scholarship renewal-eligible; student is intended recipient; reminder configured.
action_or_input: Configured renewal-reminder date/time is reached.
expected_result: System sends reminder to eligible student and records the notification event.

purpose: Verify no reminder is sent if award is no longer renewal-eligible.
preconditions: Reminder trigger reached; award is no longer renewal-eligible.
action_or_input: System rechecks active renewal window/eligibility.
expected_result: No reminder is sent.

purpose: Verify sending only the due stage when multiple reminder stages are configured.
preconditions: Multiple reminder stages configured; current trigger matches one stage.
action_or_input: Current reminder trigger is reached.
expected_result: System sends only the stage due at the current trigger.

purpose: Verify handling of renewal reminder delivery failure.
preconditions: Reminder trigger reached; notification mechanism fails.
action_or_input: System attempts to send renewal reminder but delivery fails.
expected_result: Failed delivery is recorded and handled without creating or approving a renewal.

purpose: Verify reassignment of pending role-based tasks upon role change.
preconditions: Changed role has pending tasks; current valid role holder available.
action_or_input: SPACS role assignment change is received from authoritative configuration.
expected_result: System routes uncompleted tasks to current role holder; preserves completed actor history.

purpose: Verify no task routing change when no pending tasks exist.
preconditions: Role assignment changes; no pending tasks exist for the role.
action_or_input: SPACS role assignment change is received.
expected_result: No task routing change is required or executed.

purpose: Verify consistent reassignment when multiple pending tasks exist.
preconditions: Role assignment changes; multiple pending role-based tasks exist.
action_or_input: SPACS role assignment change is received.
expected_result: All eligible role-based pending tasks are reassigned consistently to the current role holder.

purpose: Verify handling when no valid current role holder can be resolved.
preconditions: Role assignment changes; no valid current role holder is available.
action_or_input: System attempts to resolve current authorized holder for pending tasks.
expected_result: Pending tasks remain uncompleted; routing problem is surfaced; completed history is unchanged.
